brief.headline: Push for ₹66.48/KG (Sayaji's price) to save ₹1.26 Cr/year — their 8.5% profit margin gives room, and we have three alternate makers ready to qualify.

priceAsk.summary: Ask them to match ₹66.48/KG, the price Sayaji Industries already gives us for Dextrose
priceAsk.basis: We pay them ₹68.45/KG today — 3.0% more than Sayaji's ₹66.48/KG for the same material. The market asking band is ₹60–81/kg (typical ₹66–73/kg), so ₹66.48/KG sits comfortably in the fair range. We should not overpay when we already have proof a competitor delivers at that price.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep 30 Days After Receipt — it's not our worst term, and cash position is already reasonable

brief.financialLeverage: They are large (₹5995.63 Cr revenue) and keep 8.5% of every sale as profit, with only 0.13x debt — so they are financially comfortable. We are a tiny 0.35% of their business, which means we have no size leverage. However, their 8.5% profit margin and 11.7% operating profit give them plenty of cushion to move on price without real pain. Push confidently on price, but know that walking away hurts us more than them because they supply 56% of our Dextrose and we are small to them.

evidence.point: We pay them 3.0% more than the lowest price we already get
They keep a comfortable profit — 8.5% of sales and 11.7% operating profit
Market asking price for Anhydrous Dextrose IP is ₹60–81/kg, typically ₹66–73/kg — our target ₹66.48/KG is well inside the fair band
evidence.figure: marketAsk askBand: ₹60–81/kg, typical: ₹66–73/kg, verdict: MARKET-FAIR (slightly favourable)

evidence.point: We spend ₹21.21 Cr with them but are only 0.35% of their ₹5995.63 Cr revenue — we are tiny to them
They have very low debt (0.13x) and solid returns (12.5% on capital) — no financial distress, no urgency

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker with ₹2359.06 Cr revenue and a B (62/100) health score — established dextrose supplier, drop-in alternate to Gujarat Ambuja and Sayaji

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist (₹842.97 Cr revenue, C 52/100 health) — growing capacity in starch and dextrose

alternates.name: Roquette India Pvt Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Indian arm of global Roquette with ₹2898.05 Cr revenue — pharma-grade dextrose and excipients, premium and very reliable quality systems

risks: They supply 56% of our Dextrose (₹21.21 Cr) — we are heavily dependent and have no approved second source yet, which weakens our walk-away threat
We are only 0.35% of their revenue, so losing us means almost nothing to them — size leverage is zero
Their profit margins (8.5% net, 11.7% operating) mean they can afford to say no if we push too hard — stay firm on ₹66.48/KG but be ready to phase the cut or tie it to higher volume
Three potential alternates exist (Gulshan, Sanstar, Roquette India) but none are qualified yet — start technical and audit work now so you have real leverage in six months
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but today we pay you ₹68.45/KG when Sayaji gives us ₹66.48/KG for the same Dextrose — let's talk about closing that 3.0% gap.
